title: Counted key frequencies
statement: Let $A$ specify the item and counter locations, let $k: bn\to\bbn$ assign a key to each item index, and let $i\in\bbn$. For an integer-valued memory map $\mu'$, the cell at address $A.cnt$ contains $0$, and for every key $t<A.nb$, the cell at address $A.cnt+(t+1)$ contains the number of indices $x<i$ with $k(x)=t$.
hypotheses_covered: The cell at address A.cnt contains zero.
